name: M7-NOV-01c free relevance-source viability
baseline: The configured PubMed validator returned zero papers and 0/3 exact target IDs with one prose query per draft in novelty-paired-baseline-v1.json.
source: The existing unauthenticated search_europepmc MCP tool; default relevance order, no account-backed or model call.
primary_query_rule: First three digit-bearing or uppercase biomedical anchor tokens in the frozen draft, in their original order; terms were recorded by the prior rejected deterministic candidate before this source trial.
primary_metric: Number of three frozen cases whose exact target PMID or DOI is among the first three returned source-stamped records for the primary query.
go_condition: Primary metric above the 0/3 baseline, zero tool errors, source IDs and DOI/PMID retained, and no model or metered API call. This only authorizes a product-boundary candidate and decision-safety checks; it does not establish scientific-quality acceptance.
stop_condition: If the primary metric remains 0/3, reject this source/query combination without production code changes. Keep Sakana-style result conditioning open only if a specific remaining gap and feasible zero-cost test are recorded.

cases.ablation_query: In motor neurons, loss of nuclear TDP-43 may expose a cryptic polyadenylation site in STMN2 pre-mRNA, reducing functional stathmin-2 and impairing axonal regeneration.
SARS-CoV-2 may require ACE2 engagement and TMPRSS2-mediated spike priming to enter susceptible human cells.
In checkpoint-treated mouse tumors, interferon-gamma sensing may induce Qa-1b and restrain CD8 T cells through NKG2A/CD94.
